triage.fix_rationale: The vulnerable versions are pinned in package-lock.json, so running npm audit fix to update it fixes most of them. package.json may also need bumps for direct dependencies such as @angular/router, @angular/cli and @angular/build, where the fix needs a newer range.
triage.hypothesis: npm audit at --audit-level=high found 17 vulnerabilities (3 critical, 9 high) in locked dependencies such as @angular/router, piscina, proxy-addr, undici, fast-uri, brace-expansion and browserslist. Newly published advisories now match the versions pinned in package-lock.json, and the log says fixes are available.
